reasons.C: Closest in stance and movement: ironic, assertive first person, quoted hypothetical speech, semicolon-balanced antitheses and a pointed epigrammatic close, though the stray contraction and stacked flourishes edge towards imitation.
reasons.A: Right confiding, period register and parenthetical asides, but leans on dashes and a chattier 'we all know her' intimacy the passage does not use, and its antitheses are less barbed.
reasons.B: Plain, even, modern expository voice with signposted 'Consider first/next' structure; lacks the passage's irony, rhetorical questions and parenthetical bite.
